name: io.github.pfrederiksen/birdweather-mcp
title: BirdWeather
description: MCP server for BirdWeather station detections, species, and stats.

environmentVariables.name: BIRDWEATHER_STATION_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional station REST API token (never logged).

environmentVariables.name: BIRDWEATHER_CACHE_TTL
environmentVariables.description: In-memory upstream cache TTL in seconds. Set 0 to disable.

environmentVariables.name: BIRDWEATHER_CACHE_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: Set false/0/no/off to disable caching; true/1/yes/on to force on. Default: enabled when TTL > 0.

environmentVariables.name: BIRDWEATHER_MAX_RETRIES
environmentVariables.description: Retries with exponential backoff on HTTP 429/5xx and timeouts (min effective 1).

environmentVariables.name: BIRDWEATHER_STATION_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional station REST API token (never logged).

environmentVariables.name: BIRDWEATHER_CACHE_TTL
environmentVariables.description: In-memory upstream cache TTL in seconds. Set 0 to disable.

environmentVariables.name: BIRDWEATHER_CACHE_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: Set false/0/no/off to disable caching; true/1/yes/on to force on. Default: enabled when TTL > 0.

environmentVariables.name: BIRDWEATHER_MAX_RETRIES
environmentVariables.description: Retries with exponential backoff on HTTP 429/5xx and timeouts (min effective 1).

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Bind host for HTTP transports. Inside Docker use 0.0.0.0 and restrict on the host.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_ALLOWED_HOSTS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated Host header patterns for streamable-HTTP (e.g. nas.example.local:*). Unset = loopback only; * = any host.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional bearer token required for HTTP /mcp (not /health).
